source_instruction: i am looking for camo colored women's running shorts with an elastic waistband.
query: Ugh, you wouldn’t believe how chaotic my morning commute was today! The local bus was running 20 minutes late because a flock of wild turkeys decided to camp out right in the middle of the main road, and none of the drivers wanted to nudge them out of the way. I ended up sprinting three blocks from the next closest stop to make it to my desk right as my 9 a.m. team check-in started, and I spilled half my iced oat milk latte down the front of my old hoodie in the process. I swear, the neighborhood wildlife has been getting bolder by the week lately—last night I even caught a raccoon trying to pry open the lid of my balcony compost bin like it was cracking a safe. Hey, I’m browsing the women’s activewear section right now and need to grab a new pair of bottoms for my weekend hikes. Can you show me options that have a drawstring waistband, that usual print I always grab, and come with a matching detachable phone wristlet? Oh, and make sure none of them go over $30, I don’t want to blow my small clothing budget for this month on just one item.

extras.text: come with a matching detachable phone wristlet
